  html_document: default

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
1. Load packages and data
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(gt)
library(ggplot2)

df <- read_csv("Nutrition__Physical_Activity__and_Obesity_-_Behavioral_Risk_Factor_Surveillance_System.csv") %>%
  clean_names()
2. Data overview
total_rows <- df %>%
  filter(total == "Total")

questions <- sort(unique(df$question))
questions

length(unique(df$location_desc))
sort(unique(df$year))
3. Create short question labels
df <- df %>%
  mutate(question_short = case_when(
    str_detect(question, "overweight classification") ~ ">18,Overweight",
    str_detect(question, "have obesity") ~ ">18,Obesity",
    str_detect(question, "at least 150 minutes a week") &
      str_detect(question, "muscle-strengthening activities") ~ "Aerobic150_Muscle",
    str_detect(question, "at least 150 minutes a week") ~ "Aerobic150",
    str_detect(question, "more than 300 minutes a week") ~ "Aerobic300",
    str_detect(question, "muscle-strengthening activities on 2 or more days a week") ~ "Muscle2Plus",
    str_detect(question, "no leisure-time physical activity") ~ "NoPhysicalActivity",
    str_detect(question, "consuming fruit less than one time daily") ~ "LowFruit",
    str_detect(question, "consuming vegetables less than one time daily") ~ "LowVegetable",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))
4. Clean subgroup variables
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    education = case_when(
      education == "Some college or technical sch" ~ "Some college or technical school",
      TRUE ~ education
    ),
    income = na_if(income, "Data not reported")
  )

education_df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(education))
income_df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(income))
age_df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(age_years))
5. Summary table
summary_table <- df %>%
  group_by(question_short) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_percentage = round(mean(data_value[total == "Total"], na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    total_sample_size = sum(sample_size[!is.na(stratification_category1)], na.rm = TRUE),
    n_locations = n_distinct(location_desc),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_table
6. Top 10 locations for each question
top10_all <- df %>%
  group_by(question_short, location_desc) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_percentage = mean(data_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(question_short) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_percentage), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()

top10_all
7. Bottom 5 locations for low fruit and low vegetable consumption
low_food_bottom5 <- df %>%
  filter(question_short %in% c("LowFruit", "LowVegetable")) %>%
  group_by(question_short, location_desc) %>%
  summarise(avg_percentage = mean(data_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(question_short) %>%
  arrange(avg_percentage, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  ungroup()

low_food_bottom5
8. Save table using gt
low_food_bottom5_gt <- low_food_bottom5 %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Bottom Five Locations for Low Fruit and Low Vegetable Consumption"
  )

low_food_bottom5_gt
9. Obesity trend over time
df %>%
  filter(question_short == ">18,Obesity") %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(avg_value = mean(data_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = avg_value)) +
  geom_line(color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Average Obesity (%)",
    title = "Obesity Trend Over Time"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
10. Top 10 locations by obesity
df %>%
  filter(question_short == ">18,Obesity") %>%
  group_by(location_desc) %>%
  summarise(avg_value = mean(data_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_value)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(location_desc, avg_value), y = avg_value)) +
  geom_col(fill = "orange") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Location",
    y = "Average Obesity (%)",
    title = "Top 10 Locations by Obesity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
11. Obesity by income group
df %>%
  filter(
    question_short == ">18,Obesity",
    !is.na(income),
    trimws(income) != "Data not reported"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = income, y = data_value)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "orange") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Income Group",
    y = "Obesity (%)",
    title = "Obesity by Income Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
12. Question relationships by age
age_df %>%
  group_by(question_short, age_years) %>%
  summarise(avg_percentage = mean(data_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age_years, y = avg_percentage, fill = question_short)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Average Percentage",
    fill = "Question"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
13. Question relationships by education
education_df %>%
  group_by(question_short, education) %>%
  summarise(avg_percentage = mean(data_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = education, y = avg_percentage, fill = question_short)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Education",
    y = "Average Percentage",
    fill = "Question"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
14. Question relationships by income
income_df %>%
  group_by(question_short, income) %>%
  summarise(avg_percentage = mean(data_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = income, y = avg_percentage, fill = question_short)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Income",
    y = "Average Percentage",
    fill = "Question"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
